sn13.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyam viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn13.1:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn13.1:1.5: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo cāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavīti || || 3
sn13.1:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idaṃ mahāpathavī ||
sn13.1:2.2: appamattako nakhasikhāyam Bhagavatā paritto paṃsu āropito ||
sn13.1:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalam upeti na sahassimaṃ kalam upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalam upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito ti || || 4
sn13.1:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etad eva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ yad idaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ
sn13.1:2.6: neva satimaṃ kalam upeti na sahassimaṃ kalam upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalam upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yad idam sattakkhattuṃ paramatā || || 5
